name: session-cockpit
description: Session Cockpit: usage limits, cost, context breakdown, environment, connectors and quick settings in a pane beside the chat

contextCap.title: Context cap (tokens)
contextCap.description: Past this, the cockpit tells you to hand off and start a fresh session

warnPercent.title: Warn at %
warnPercent.description: Toast once when context or a rate-limit window passes this percentage

advisorBudget.title: Advisor calls per session
advisorBudget.description: Advisor calls past this show as over budget

pinnedAgents.title: Agents that set their own model
pinnedAgents.description: Comma-separated agent types that never warn when spawned without a model
